title: Record observed thaw
purpose: Add one observed thaw episode to a specimen's thaw records.
summary: Add one observed thaw to a specimen's thaw records.

tasks.title: Record a thaw
steps: Enter [[When it happened]] and describe what was observed in [[Reason]].

tasks.title: Correct a thaw record
steps: Admin and manager: use the correction action on the thaw record in the specimen record.

good_to_know: Record only a thaw someone actually observed and that was not already recorded at check-in.
Leaving storage is not a thaw.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Admin, manager and technician can use this form; a viewer is refused.

When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice giving the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee.

The top of the form repeats the specimen ID (a link back to the record), status including any active holds, amount on hand and location, so you can confirm you are acting on the right specimen. The location reads Checked out to the person and destination while checked out, Returned, in hand of the person who received it (with where it came back from) after a return from outside the repository, and Distributed: outside the repository while it is away in a shipment.
It is refused for a disposed specimen and for a distributed one: material sent out of the repository in a shipment takes no physical step until its return is recorded.

Use it only for a thaw you or someone actually observed that was not already recorded at a check-in. Leaving storage is not a thaw. A thaw history that was never observed stays unknown; it is not guessed.

items.label: When it happened
items.description: Required. Repository local time to the second; not in the future and not before the specimen's last recorded event.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, up to 2,000 characters. Kept in the history with the change. Describe what was observed. Do not enter names, record numbers, birth dates, contact details or other text that could identify a donor.

sections.title: Saving and rules
paragraphs: Record observed thaw adds a thaw record with a count of 1 and raises the observed total shown under Thaws. Admin and manager can later correct a record. Hidden revision numbers are captured when the form opens. If the specimen was changed by someone else meanwhile, the save is refused with “Specimen VP-… changed since you opened it. Reload it, check the current state and try again” (or, for storage changes, “The specimen's storage location changed since you opened this page… Reload it and try again”). Nothing is saved; reopen the form from the specimen record to pick up the current state before entering the action again.

Times are repository local time, entered to the second. A time cannot be in the future or before the specimen's latest recorded event (the message names that event's time). A time within the same second as that event is taken as that event's own time, so recording straight after another event keeps the order. The form starts at the current time.
